caption: The drawing depicts an object composed mainly of a large transparent cylindrical glass bottle with a narrow neck mounted horizontally on a wooden frame. The bottle is held in place by two vertical wooden supports, one on each side, which are attached to a horizontal wooden base. A hand crank with a curved metal arm and a wooden handle is attached to the left end of the bottle's axis, allowing the bottle to be rotated. The wooden frame is brown, with visible wood grain texture, and consists of a T-shaped base with a central vertical support intersected by a horizontal plank. Behind the glass bottle, there is a piece of dark gray or black fabric or material, rectangular in shape, which hangs vertically. The colors used include varying shades of brown for the wood, gray and transparent hues for the glass, metallic gray for the crank arm, and a darker color for the fabric. The composition is centered on the page, and the name "Carl Benjamin" is written in blue ink at the bottom right corner of the drawing. The background is a plain, light cream color.
title: Electric Generator
